title: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab, (1980) 2 SCC 684
content.holding: Death is the exception: rarest of rare, after weighing aggravating and mitigating circumstances. Governs sentencing under s. 103.

sources.label: Official Supreme Court of India judgment PDF; inspected for identity, date, citation, issues and majority holdings.

evidence.note: Original judgment inspected; material propositions confirmed from the headnote and opening 159-page judgment.

verificationNote: Verified against the official Supreme Court of India judgment PDF. The official record gives judgment date 16 August 1982, five-judge bench, AIR 1982 SC 1325 and (1982) 3 SCC 24. The majority upheld Section 302 IPC and Section 354(3) CrPC and held that death penalty should be reserved for exceptional cases, with 'special reasons' understood in that context.
